$comment: Machine-local SC-04 local capability config (ARTHUR_LOCAL_CONFIG points here). Copy to a git-ignored machine-local path and set ARTHUR_LOCAL_CONFIG to it. Uses the exact LocalCapabilityConfig schema: filesystem_roots bind root_id -> { label, trusted absolute physical_root, permissions }; applications bind app_id -> { display_name, trusted absolute executable, fixed args, optional windows_verb }. No auto-discovery, no model-provided paths. Never commit the real file: physical paths differ per machine.
